div.p: Fill out this form to request a facility booking. All event requests require board approval before confirmation. A deposit will be required.

input.name: customer_name
input.title: Your full name — this is who the booking is under.

input.name: customer_email
input.title: We'll send your confirmation and updates to this address.

input.name: customer_phone
input.title: The best phone number to reach you about your event.

select.name: is_member
select.title: Elk members may qualify for a member discount.

input.name: member_number
input.title: Your Elks membership number (required for the member rate).

input.name: event_name
input.title: A short name for your event, e.g. 'Smith Wedding Reception'.

select.name: event_type
select.title: The kind of event you're hosting.

input.name: guest_count
input.title: Approximate number of guests — this helps us plan staffing and the room.

div.label: Event Date *

input.name: event_date
input.title: The date of your event. Already-reserved dates can't be booked.

div.small: That date is already reserved — please choose another.

input.name: end_time
input.title: What time your event ends (events must end by midnight).

div.label: Is this Celebration of Life for an Elk?

select.name: col_is_elk
select.title: Was the person being honored an Elk member?

input.name: col_member_number
input.title: Member number of the person being honored — the facility is no charge and family receives the member rate.

input.name: col_home_lodge
input.title: Home lodge name/number of the person being honored.

img.title: Map of the lodge — see where each room is located.

textarea.name: event_description
textarea.title: Tell us what you're planning so we can prepare.

textarea.name: special_requests
textarea.title: Anything special we should know — accessibility, timing, vendors, etc.

div.p: Estimates are fine — staff will confirm the details with you.

select.name: num_bars
select.title: How many bars you'd like open (the lodge has a limited number of bar locations).

div.label: Check anything you'll need:

div.title: A podium for speeches or presentations.

div.title: House sound system for music or announcements.
div.label: Sound System

div.label: Microphone

div.label: Linens

div.title: A beer tub for self-serve canned/bottled beer.
div.label: Beer Tub

div.title: You'll be bringing or arranging decorations.
div.label: Decorations

select.name: insurance_by
select.title: Insurance is required for every event. Either have the lodge provide it (added to your quote), or provide your own certificate naming Lewiston Elks Lodge #896 as additional insured.
select.option: I need the lodge to provide insurance (added to my quote)
I will provide my own certificate (naming Lewiston Elks Lodge #896 as additional insured)

div.div:
Prohibited activities. The facility-rental insurance does NOT cover events that include any of the following:
An Elks function or Elks-sponsored activity
Motorized vehicles / motorcycles / watercraft
Fireworks
Gun and/or knife shows
Inflatable amusement devices/rides (bounce houses, slides, climbing towers)
Mechanical amusement rides
Organized athletic events and competitions (billiards, darts, shuffleboard, cornhole are OK)
I confirm none of the above are part of this event. *

select.title: Who sets the room up — the lodge, or you?

select.name: takedown_by
select.title: Who tears the room down afterward — the lodge, or you?

input.name: linen_qty
input.title: How many linens you need (if Linens is checked).

select.name: linen_color
select.title: Choose a base color, or 'Other' to request a specific color.

input.name: linen_color_other
input.title: Tell us the linen color you'd like.

div.title: Check if you'd like the lodge to provide food/catering. All food is catered through the lodge.

textarea.title: Specific dishes or menu items you'd like.

textarea.title: Anything else you'll need that isn't listed above.

input.title: Link to your Facebook event page, if you have one.

input.title: Any other website related to your event.
